text.en:
Sub-items (g), (i) and (j) of Item 37, Subsection (e), Title B of section one, Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(g) For construction and/or repairs of Barrio Cansayang Elementary School, San Juan ₱10,000.00 "(i) Purchase of municipal building site and construction of municipal building, Siaton 10,000.00 "(j) Repair of the Palimpinon-Caidyocan Road, Valencia 5,000.00"

Item 55, Group I, subsection (a), Title G of section one, Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"55. Liloan feeder road, Maria, Negros Oriental ₱15,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1955.
